p1_findings.title: Contract-required phase aggregates are absent
p1_findings.evidence: contract.required_reporting requires phase/sample-module/module/sample/overall integer counter aggregates, but aggregate_breakdowns emits only overall, sample:*, module:* and record:* buckets. Per-record phase leaves do not provide the required cross-record phase aggregate.
p1_findings.risk: The canonical report would violate its reporting contract and force the post-result reviewer to reconstruct a missing primary breakdown outside the sealed result.
p1_findings.required_repair: Add phase:{3,2,1,0} ratio-of-summed integer-counter aggregates over the identical population, unit-test conservation from phase to overall, and freeze new runner/contract/test SHA identities.

p1_findings.title: Double-sealed failure receipt does not cover execution/preflight failures
p1_findings.evidence: main calls authorization, preflight and both execute_records populations before atomic_publish creates staging. The only m693_failure_receipt_v1 handler is inside atomic_publish, so any official worker/preflight failure exits without the contract-required double-sealed failure receipt.
p1_findings.risk: A long official replay can fail closed with no canonical result but also without the frozen negative receipt promised by output.failure_receipt_double_seal_required.
p1_findings.required_repair: Create a fresh noncanonical staging/failure root before preflight/execution or wrap main so every failure writes a non-overwriting double-sealed failure receipt; add an injected execute_records failure test.

p2_findings.title: Worker-count equivalence remains static reasoning only
p2_findings.evidence: executor.map ordering, final sorting and worker-local initialization are deterministic by inspection, but the static package has no 1/2/3-worker output-hash miter and the final report does not record the selected worker count.
p2_findings.required_repair: Bind workers=3 in the unique command and receipt, or add a lightweight injected-worker equivalence test; full official triple replay is not required before launch.

p2_findings.title: Non-overwrite is checked before os.rename rather than atomically enforced
p2_findings.evidence: atomic_publish checks not output.exists(), then later uses os.rename(staging, output), leaving a benign-concurrency TOCTOU window.
p2_findings.required_repair: Document the single-writer assumption or use a no-replace publication primitive/lock in r2.
